items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Yeah, Didi used to be the leader there.

ctx.x: Yeah, Didi used to be the leader there. That's right. The trumpet player. I remember when he was playing with John. Yeah.
Little Cag. Little Cag used to work with John. Cag didn't work with John much. Lawrence Tucker worked with John.
